atoms.text: Next, Dusty is going to show you some animals on a farm.

instruction.text: Answer Dusty’s question by listening to the options and selecting the correct answer.

atoms.sound: ssml:<voice voiceLang='en' voice='m8'>Why are farm animals needed?</voice>

b.sound: They provide animal products, such as eggs, milk, wool and meat.
They help farmers drive their tractors.

instruction.text: Select the three images of farm animals.

feedback.finish: We can get useful products from farm animals. These are domesticated animals, which means they are kept by humans and are safe to work with!
feedback.wrong: Lions are not found on farms.

instruction.text: This is a chicken coop. Select the chickens to learn more.

end.text: A coop is like a little house for the chickens to keep them safe and warm. They can also be let outside for fresh air!
end.sound: A coopp is like a little house for the chickens to keep them safe and warm. They can also be let outside for fresh air!

instruction.text: This is a pasture. Select the grass to learn more.

feedback.end: A pasture is a large area of grass where farm animals can feed. You can find cows, sheep and horses enjoying the fresh grass here!

instruction.text: This is a sty. Select one of the pigs to learn more.

feedback.end: A sty is a home for pigs. It houses lots of pigs together and sometimes comes with an outdoor area for them too. We get pork, bacon and most sausages from pigs!

instruction.text: Drag the images of farm animals to the products you get from them.
Let’s do some fieldwork! Dusty wants to count the number of animals on this farm. Answer Dusty’s question.

feedback.correct1: We can use paper and a pencil to note down the number of animals we see.
feedback.correct2: We can use binoculars to see animals that are further away.
feedback.correct3: We can use a map to find our way around the farm.

atoms.a: “What three tools might be useful for our fieldwork?”
atoms.sound: ssml:<voice voiceLang='en' voice='m8'>What three tools might be useful for our fieldwork?</voice>

instruction.text: We’re now outside on the farm! Select all the correct animals on the image.

feedback.finish: It’s a great idea to visit farms to see where your food comes from!
